testcase.name: truncated or non-audio files fail clearly
pause stops output and resume continues
index lookup is monotonic and clamped
seek restarts from the right frame and discards the old sink
plays a track to the end and reports it
volume changes apply to the frames that follow
mono 48k decodes to the 880 Hz tone
fragmented mp4 like YouTube's is demuxed
explicit no-SBR extension is trimmed, real SBR and HE-AAC are kept
decoded audio really is the 440 Hz tone, at full length
